description: Dependency policy shared by gokayo43's Bun projects.

packageRules.description: Non-major updates land as one automerged PR per week.
Majors are read before they are merged.
This repo's own pins carry executable gate code. Automerging one would land a gate that the adopting PR never showed anybody.
An Expo SDK is one release across every package it ships. A partial bump builds and then fails on a device, so the packages move together and a human reads the SDK's changelog before they do.
Better Auth's plugins are versioned in lockstep with the core; a plugin ahead of the core fails at import.

customManagers.description: Released binaries pinned by tag and archive SHA-256 — inside a run: block, which no built-in manager reads, or in a shell script a person runs on the box. The renovate: comment above the pair names the dependency, so one manager covers every tool pinned this way, in either spelling of an assignment.
The same gitleaks pin appears unhashed in this repo's local install instructions.
